title: Part 1 Normal Force
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly calculated as mg.

title: Part 2 Angular Velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly derived as ω = √(2g/R).

title: Part 3 Friction Magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (3) must correctly give the magnitude of friction as ((√3 - 1)/2)mg.

title: Apply Newton's Second Law
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply Newton's second law to resolve forces into centripetal and vertical components at points A and B.

title: Correct Geometry for Radius
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly identify the radius of circular motion at point A as R sin α and at point B as R sin β.

title: Part 3 Friction Direction
description: Important Criteria: For part (3), the solution must correctly state the direction of friction at point B (e.g., perpendicular to OB and downward/tangential up the slope).

title: Sign or Direction Error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize sign errors in force components (e.g., incorrect sine/cosine for α or β, or wrong sign for friction in equations).

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The solution maintains consistent units throughout the derivation and final answers.
